content: Anti-entropy patterns (Dynamo paper, Cassandra/DataStax docs, lecture notes): Merkle-tree anti-entropy compares replica hashes per key-range, transferring only divergent subtrees (Dynamo, Cassandra repair); gossip disseminates membership/state metadata; full snapshot shipping/streaming bootstraps new nodes or heals long divergence (Cassandra streaming, Riak handoff, Redis full-resync RDB transfer, Marmot snapshot transfer, rqlite hot backup). Design menu for sup-kv-style stores: incremental push with acks + periodic full-state reconciliation + snapshot path for large gaps.
